# CR Coffee Shop

> CR Coffee Shop is a locally owned New Orleans coffee shop and online coffee brand serving antique-roasted Coast Roast beans at four locations and shipping nationwide. Every batch is roasted slowly on antique 1910s Royal No. 6 drum roasters on the Mississippi Gulf Coast, giving a naturally sweeter, smoother cup. Founded in 2015 by Kevin Pedeaux at St. Roch Market.

Canonical site: https://crcoffeenola.com/
Full story and FAQ: https://crcoffeenola.com/about
Coffee guide (blends, roasting, sourcing): https://crcoffeenola.com/coffee

## Who runs it

Kevin Pedeaux founded CR Coffee Shop in 2015 and co-founded Coast Roast Coffee in 2009 with Shawn Montella. Shawn owns and runs the roastery on the Mississippi Gulf Coast; Kevin selects every coffee CR pours and sells, runs the New Orleans shops, and handles Coast Roast's wholesale (custom blends for over 100 shops nationwide). CR serves Coast Roast Coffee exclusively.

- Old Metairie: 603 1/2 Metairie Rd, Metairie, LA 70005. Mon-Fri 6am to 6pm, Sat-Sun 7am to 6pm. (504) 264-7671. https://crcoffeenola.com/old-metairie

Rewards (CR Coffee Rewards, 1 Bean per $1, free drink at 100 Beans): Magazine Street and Old Metairie only. https://crcoffeenola.com/rewards

## The coffee

All five blends are $19.75 per 12 oz bag, whole bean or ground, roasted close to ship date, shipping anywhere in the U.S. from https://cr-coffee-shop.square.site/shop/at-home-coffee-and-tea/4

- Streetcar Blend (medium roast, house coffee): full body, light acidity, smooth and satisfying finish. https://crcoffeenola.com/streetcar-blend
- French Roast (dark roast): smoked cocoa, dark caramel, hint of charred cedar, dark without the burn. https://crcoffeenola.com/french-roast
- St. Roch Blend (coffee and chicory): cocoa body, caramelized chicory sweetness, soft balanced finish. Higher ratio of coffee to chicory than most New Orleans blends. https://crcoffeenola.com/st-roch-blend (chicory coffee guide: https://crcoffeenola.com/chicory-coffee)
- Cold Brew Blend: smooth cocoa body, dark caramel, clean mellow finish. Grind coarse, steep 18 hours, cut 1:1. https://crcoffeenola.com/cold-brew-blend
- CR Espresso Blend: bittersweet cocoa, dark caramel, stone fruit, velvety finish. Built for milk. 100% Arabica, Central and South American. https://crcoffeenola.com/espresso-blend

Green beans come through the Port of New Orleans (the second-largest coffee port in the United States) and direct farm relationships in Central and South America.

## The drinks

Menu: https://crcoffeenola.com/drinks
Signatures: Cold Brew Cubano (cold brew topped with Cuban espresso), Sweet Vanilla Cream Cold Brew (best-seller, 18-hour steep, house vanilla cream), Cafe au Lait (Roch Blend coffee-and-chicory with steamed milk, 50/50), Chocolate-Covered Espresso Bean Frozen. Espresso drinks, drip, and chai. All syrups house-made.

## Wholesale

Coast Roast Coffee is available wholesale for restaurants, offices, and retailers; CR supplies custom blends to over 100 shops nationwide. Inquiries: https://crcoffeenola.com/contact?topic=Wholesale or coastroastcoffeestroch@gmail.com. https://crcoffeenola.com/wholesale
